claim: Google DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework v1 (May 2024) defines 'Critical Capability Levels' (CCLs) for CBRN, cyber, and AI R&D acceleration.

source.excerpt: We define Critical Capability Levels (CCLs) for CBRN, cybersecurity, and AI R&D acceleration. When a model approaches a CCL, we apply additional mitigations.

provenance.context: Google DeepMind Frontier Safety Framework v1 (May 2024). URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/DeepMind-FSF-Framework-v1.pdf

claim: Google DeepMind's FSF v1 prescribes three tiers of mitigations (yellow, red, black) keyed to CCL crossings.

source.excerpt: Three tiers of response: yellow (enhanced monitoring), red (deployment restrictions), black (deployment pause). Tier selection depends on the CCL crossed and confidence in assessment.

provenance.context: Google DeepMind FSF v1, §3 Mitigation tiers. URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/deepmind-media/DeepMind-FSF-Framework-v1.pdf

claim: Google's Gemini 2.5 Deep Research (May 2025) was launched with FSRI 2 security mitigations after Gemini 2.5 Pro's CBRN uplift studies reached 'early warning' threshold.

source.excerpt: Gemini 2.5 Deep Research was launched with FSRI 2 mitigations. CBRN uplift studies for Gemini 2.5 Pro reached early warning threshold under FSF v1.

claim: Google operated an internal Responsibility & Safety Council (RSC) with cross-functional review authority over model deployments in 2024-2025.

source.excerpt: Our Responsibility & Safety Council reviews model deployment decisions across all frontier model launches.

provenance.context: Google AI Responsibility & Safety Council description (Dec 2024 update). URL: https://ai.google/responsibility/safety-council

claim: Google DeepMind submitted a Winter 2025 FLI Index survey response.

source.excerpt: Google DeepMind submitted a response to the FLI Winter 2025 survey.

provenance.context: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 Appendix A. URL: https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_131225_Full_Report_Digital.pdf

claim: Google published its 2024 AI Responsibility Report covering governance, evaluation practices, and model deployment policies.

source.excerpt: Google's 2024 AI Responsibility Report covers governance structures, evaluation practices for frontier models, and deployment policies.
